title: Abelian group given by generators and relations
statement: Let $I$ and $J$ be sets and let $r:J\to\mathbf Z^{(I)}$ be a family of finitely supported integer-valued functions on $I$. Here $\mathbf Z^{(I)}$ is the free $\mathbf Z$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module] of finitely supported functions $I\to\mathbf Z$, with pointwise addition, and $e_i$ is the function equal to $1$ at $i$ and $0$ elsewhere. The abelian group presented by these generators and relations is $G(I,J,r)=\mathbf Z^{(I)}/\langle r(j):j\in J\rangle_{\mathbf Z}$, where the denominator consists of all finite integer linear combinations of the $r(j)$. Write $[i]$ for the coset of $e_i$ in this quotient.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: take A := ℤ and relations := Module.Relations.mk I J r (structure at line 55). Quotient at line 70 is definitionally (I →₀ ℤ) modulo Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range r); its AddCommGroup is derived at line 71. The coset [i] is Module.Relations.toQuotient (line 74) applied to Finsupp.single i 1. Integer submodule span is precisely the subgroup of finite integer linear combinations, so no comparison theorem is needed.
